source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 632 and PDF page 22 Military Retirement Income and/or Survivor's Benefits Deduction; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000), line 4 (PDF page 25: 1,000 age 65 or older), line 5 (PDF page 25: 500 age 65 or older and IT-40 line 1 under 40,000, or under 20,000 married filing separately); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = military retirement person 0 42,000.00 + military retirement person 1 18,000.00 + IRA distribution person 0 9,000.00 = 69,000.00. Federal taxable income = 69,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 35,900.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 69,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 69,000.00 + 0.00 = 69,000.00. Schedule 2: line 11 code 632 military retirement 60,000.00; line 12 total = 60,000.00. IT-40 line 4 = 60,000.00. Line 5 = 69,000.00 - 60,000.00 = 9,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 2,000.00; line 4 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00; line 5 IT-40 line 1 69,000.00 is not less than 40,000.00: none; line 7 total = 3,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 3,000.00. Line 7 = 9,000.00 - 3,000.00 = 6,000.00. Line 8 = 6,000.00 x 0.03 = 180.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 180.00. Each spouse claims the whole of their own military retirement income.
